status: PLAN ONLY - NOTHING FETCHED, NOTHING PRICED
gate: PRICE FIRST. FETCH ONLY after explicit authorization.
why_needed: no existing file carries contract identity, expiry or a roll log; genuine NQ intraday coverage is 7 trade days at 1m and 51 at 5m

target.escalation_if_candidate_A: trades or mbp-1 (aggressor side) - far larger and costlier

already_implements: runtime endpoint restriction via exact-match frozenset
three metadata methods (get_cost, get_record_count, get_billable_size) on ONE identical definition request
HALT on malformed metadata, naming the failing method, shape-only info
no 'mode' parameter (absent from Databento's documented signature)
request-schema contract test asserting 'mode' NOT in the get_cost request
API key read from DATABENTO_API_KEY, never printed/logged/committed/in exceptions

safeguards_carried_forward: dataset must be GLBX.MDP3 (CME) - never an equity/CFD dataset
discover contracts from definition/reference data; never fabricate raw symbols
filter OUTRIGHTS only; exclude calendar spreads (the parent symbol includes them)
raw symbols are not globally durable economic identities - do not treat them as such
order contracts by expiration / contract month, NEVER ticker lexicographically
construct roll decisions CAUSALLY (no future volume peeking)
CME trade-day-aware volume aggregation, not UTC-day
retain pre-roll incoming-contract history for causal warm-up
never carry a price level from one contract into another
preserve source contract on EVERY bar
API end times are exclusive where applicable
metadata price estimation must not trigger billable timeseries retrieval

staged_sequence.action: definition/reference discovery of NQ outrights + expirations
price discovery: get_cost + get_record_count + get_billable_size on ONE identical query
report exact cost to the user and STOP
fetch ohlcv-1m per contract, source contract retained
causal roll construction + active-contract research series
formal data quality gate (section 5 of the instruction)

quality_gate_tests_to_freeze_before_rese: missing 1m intervals in expected trading periods
halt_policy: every failure HALTS or is handled by a rule frozen BEFORE performance research. Questionable data is never silently repaired.
back_adjustment_policy: a continuous back-adjusted series may exist for visualization or long-horizon returns ONLY. It must NEVER supply liquidity levels, session highs/lows, VWAP, sweep penetration, stop/target prices, tick calculations or event formation - those come from the actual active contract, so a contract switch cannot make an old price level appear to exist in a new contract.

known_free_alternatives_considered.yahoo_NQ=F: already held; front-month continuous, undocumented roll, 7d of 1m - INSUFFICIENT
known_free_alternatives_considered.note: no free source known to this project provides contract-level CME NQ intraday history
